notes.title: Fallout Shelter - Update 1.12
notes.notes:
Update 1.12 is now available for Fallout Shelter!

What’s New in Version 1.12

Once again, Vault-Tec delivers on its promise of a brave new world of Quests! 

Fight the Horsemen, recruit Three Dog and get a new Legendary Outfit in the epic conclusion to Horsemen of the Post-Apocalypse!
Spice things up as the Vault’s new chef sends you on dangerous missions to find the perfect seasoning!
Solve a murder mystery, investigate potential alien sightings, compete in a beauty pageant, and more!
Further improvements and tuning of Vault-Tec simulation capacitors.
